questions.question: If 11 November 2009 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 17 November 2013?
questions.solution:
Given: **11 November 2009** was Wednesday.

Now,

2009 to 2013 = 4 Years (3 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 4 Years = 1 Leap year and 3 Ordinary Year.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 3 Ordinary Year has 3 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 3 = 5.

then, 11 November 2013 will be Wednesday + 5 = Monday.

Now, the number of days between 11 November 2013 to 17 November 2013

= 6 days.

So, **17 November 2013** will be Monday + 6 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements :**

Some roses are flowers.

All buds are roses.

All lilies are flowers.

**Conclusion (I) :** Some buds are lilies.

**Conclusion (II) : **All flowers are buds.
questions.solution:
Given statements: 

Some roses are flowers.

All buds are roses.

All lilies are flowers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/498379751d051fb4f36d9ea2e037162382029dd7f584d5e4fd747752265f08e6.png] 

Conclusion:

(I) : Some buds are lilies → False (Because, There is no direct relative between buds and lilies, so it can be possible)

(II) : All flowers are buds → False (Because, There is no direct relative between buds and lilies, so it can be possible)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

55 × 84 - 12 + 9 ÷ 26 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 55 × 84 - 12 + 9 ÷ 26 = ?

Now, if '+' and '×' and '-' and '÷' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 55 + __**84 **____**÷ 12**__ × 9 - 26 = ?

⇒ ? = 55 + __**7 ×**____** 9**__ - 26

⇒ ? = __**55 + 63**__ - 26

⇒ ? = __**118 - 26**__ = 92

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘–’, then the resultant of which of the following will be 338?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘–’ then; 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 32 D 11 B 80 A 4 C 6

After replacing the letter with signs we get;

⇒ 32 - 11 × **__80 ÷ 4__** + 6

⇒ 32 - __**11 × **____20__ + 6

⇒ __**32**__ - 220 __**+ 6**__

⇒ __**36 - 220**__ = -184

Option 2) 32 C 11 D 80 A 4 B 6

After replacing the letter with signs we get;

⇒ 32 + 11 - __**80 ÷ 4**__ × 6

⇒ 32 + 11 - __20____** × 6**__

⇒ __**32 + 11**__ - 120

⇒ **__43 - 120__** = - 77

**Option 3) 32 B 11 D 80 A 4 C 6**

**After replacing the letter with signs we get;**

⇒ 32 × 11 - __**80 ÷ 4**__ + 6

⇒ __**32 **____**× 11**__ - 20 + 6

⇒ __352__ - 20 __**+ 6**__

⇒ __358__**__ - __****__20__** = 338

Option 4) 32 A 11 D 80 B 4 C 6

After replacing the letter with signs we get;

⇒ **32 ÷ 11** - 80 × 4 + 6

⇒ 2.9 - __**80 **____**× 4**__ + 6

⇒ 2.9 - 320 **__+ 6__**

⇒ __**8**____**.9 - 320**__ = 311.1

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: After 36 days it will be a Sunday. What day is it today?
questions.solution:
Given: **After 36 days it will be a Sunday**.

Now,

The number of days in a week = 7.

So, 36 days → 36/7 = 5 weeks and 1 odd day.

Thus, 36 days from today will be 5 weeks and 1 day ahead of today.

Since 36 days from today is a Sunday,

1 day before Sunday is Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(59, 246, 23)

(68, 300, 32)

(**NOTE : **Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 3rd number) × 3 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, (59, 246, 23)

→ (59 + 23) × 3 = 82 × 3 = 246.

For, (68, 300, 32)

→ (68 + 32) × 3 = 100 × 3 = 300.

Similarly, for **(42, 213, 29)**

**→ (42 + 29) × 3 = 71 × 3 = 213 **

The correct answer is Option 2.
